name: taste-detector
description: Emil Kowalski's full design-engineering skill family (animation, motion, component-craft, native mobile-web feel, Expo, Sonner, Swift), vendored and auto-invoking, plus a global PostToolUse hook that runs impeccable's own detector on every UI edit and turns whatever it finds into a nudge toward the right skill in the family - never invokes a skill itself, only makes the reminder and its targeting deterministic instead of relying on memory.
